extra.zh: 类别：隐藏与壮举。外形为多角章：竖立的菱形章，乌银边（#4a4a52），底色炭黑（#24242e）。
extra.en: Category: hidden and feats. Multi-pointed badge: an upright lozenge with a blackened silver rim (#4a4a52), charcoal field (#24242e).

items.notes: 语法：外形与边色=事迹类别（隐藏与壮举），中央纹样=这条事迹在凡人眼里的场面；壮举在徽章下沿加一枝小月桂。徽章上不画文字与数字，人物只画剪影不画脸。隐藏事迹。门上不画门牌号与字。

subject.zh: 一枚隐藏与壮举类事迹徽章，乌银边、炭黑底的竖菱形章；中央纹样：一座冷着的熔炉前整齐码着一摞门铜色的厚书，炉膛里没有火；菱形章下尖加一枝小月桂。
subject.en: A deed badge of the hidden and feats category, a blackened-silver upright lozenge badge with a charcoal field; central motif: a stack of thick gatebronze-colored books neatly piled before a cold furnace with no fire in its mouth; a small laurel sprig at the lower tip of the lozenge.

extra.en: Category: hidden and feats. Multi-pointed badge: an upright lozenge with a blackened silver rim (#4a4a52), charcoal field (#24242e).
